s1.desc: a snowy clearing with snow-covered pine trees under a pale sky

spans.view: with a campfire under a steaming pot on a wooden tripod beside him

beats.text: Pax stands beside the campfire with his flippers folded over his chest, frowning sideways at the steaming pot

spans.view: with a campfire under a steaming pot on a wooden tripod beside him

beats.text: Pax sways with his eyes squeezed shut and his flippers held out at his sides
Pax hops up and down on the spot with his flippers pressed to his cheeks
Pax leans in toward the steaming pot and jabs one flipper out at it
Pax pulls back upright with his flippers raised, squeezing his eyes shut, then opening them in a frown
Pax stands with his flippers at his chest, glaring at the pot with a determined frown
Pax stretches one flipper out toward the pot, then spreads both flippers wide, still frowning

beats.text: Pax, small in the distance, scrambles up the steep slope of the volcano toward the crater
Pax reaches the rim of the glowing crater and stands at its edge
Pax leaps high into the rising smoke above the crater
Pax drops back down toward the glowing crater
